name: Ancient Ksour of Ouadane, Chinguetti, Tichitt and Oualata
description: Scattered across the Mauritanian Sahara, four old desert towns (Ouadane, Chinguetti, Tichitt and Oualata) began as caravan stops in the 11th and 12th centuries. Their stone houses cluster along narrow lanes around a mosque with a square minaret. Once lively centres of trade and Islamic learning, they are now slowly being swallowed by the advancing sands.
